issues.problem: Seven meeting chairs form one long row on the west side of the short conference table; these four sit beyond the table ends and do not have usable places at the table.
issues.fix: Redistribute these chairs around the opposite side and ends of the conference table, with each chair facing inward and aligned with reachable tabletop space.

issues.problem: The tall storage shelf stands in front of an east-wall window, obstructing the window and reducing its light and usability.
issues.fix: Move the shelf to a solid section of wall that does not overlap a window, keeping its front accessible.
